blocks.text: 今年早些时候，我们推出了 Project Genie，这是一个实验性研究原型，可以生成并探索交互式世界。早期测试者告诉我们，他们希望能更深入地控制这些世界中发生的事情，也希望有更便捷的方式来构建和分享它们。

inlines.text: 今年早些时候，我们

blocks.text: 因此今天，我们向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户推出全新的 Project Genie 体验，让这些世界更具响应性、创造力和社交性。本次更新首次开放 Genie 4 的使用权限，带来 Genie 3 的多项升级，还加入了帮助用户实现构想的 Project Genie 智能体，以及一个可供发现、探索和混编世界的社区画廊。

blocks.text: 在 Project Genie 中体验 Genie 4

inlines.text: 在 Project Genie 中体验 Genie 4

blocks.text: 借助 Genie 4——我们迄今最逼真、交互性最强的世界模型——你现在可以在会话中途输入提示词来改变已创建的世界。只需在探索世界时输入新的提示词，就能实时编辑环境：切换天气、加入角色，或者改变剧情走向。Genie 4 首次将这些画面与实时原生音频结合，音频会随场景变化而调整，从环境音景到角色对白皆可覆盖。

inlines.text: Genie 4 带来了最高保真度的画面、物理效果和原生音频，而当你需要更长的运行时间或以全景图作为初始场景的空间时，仍可在 Project Genie 的模型选择器中使用 Genie 3。本次 Genie 3 的更新包括：

每次生成可探索最长 3 分钟（此前为 60 秒），也可以将多个世界连接起来，开启更长的旅程。

blocks.text: 创造全新的交互体验

inlines.text: 创造全新的交互体验

blocks.text: 全新的 Project Genie 智能体让创作不再局限于单条文本或图像提示词。如今，打造一个交互式宇宙就像聊天一样轻松。你只需用自然语言描述自己的构想，智能体便会调度 Google 的多模态模型套件，生成奠定世界标志性外观的初始画面，并配上契合氛围的定制背景音乐。

inlines.text: 全新的 Project Genie 智能体让创作不再局限于单条文本或图像提示词。如今，打造一个交互式宇宙就像聊天一样轻松。你只需用自然语言描述自己的构想，智能体便会调度 Google 的多模态模型套件，生成奠定世界标志性外观的初始画面，并配上契合氛围的定制背景音乐。

blocks.text: 在探索过程中，你还可以让 Gemini 模型加入会话：它会观察屏幕上发生的事情，给出与情境相关的建议选项，提示下一步可以去哪里，或者随着旅程推进自动触发世界内事件。

blocks.text: 探索全新画廊

inlines.text: 探索全新画廊

blocks.text: 如果你只想直接开始探索，全新的 Project Genie 画廊汇集了丰富的精选世界，以及来自社区的创意作品。在“Living Memory”中把个人照片变成可探索的空间；在“Dino Field Guide”中漫步于以 360 度全景图为依据的丰富史前栖息地；或者在“Rock Paper Scissors”中让主题物件在桌面上两两对决，由 Gemini 担任实时裁判。

blocks.text: 画廊还展示了与一批先行创作者的精彩合作，他们提前获得了这些工具的使用权限。我们与创意技术专家 Will（又名 BLVCKL!GHT）合作，打造了“Villa Giallo”——一座哥特式庄园内氛围十足、逐房间展开的悬疑体验。我们还与电影制作人 Anand Gandhi 一起构建了“The Life of Ants”，邀请你以蚂蚁的视角穿行于一个复杂的蚁群，充分展现了 Genie 4 令人惊叹的照片级真实感。

inlines.text: 了解我们如何负责任地构建

blocks.text: 我们致力于负责任地开发和推出交互式世界模型。Project Genie 生成的所有视频和音频都包含 SynthID 水印，所有模型输入和输出都要经过安全筛查。

inlines.text: 我们致力于负责任地开发和推出交互式世界模型。Project Genie 生成的所有视频和音频都包含 SynthID 水印，所有模型输入和输出都要经过安全筛查。

blocks.text: Genie 3 和 Genie 4 仍属于前沿研究领域的世界模型。随着研究不断推进，我们正在积极应对镜头延迟、复杂物理交互、实时音频精度和长期场景持久性等关键挑战。如需深入了解模型局限以及我们在这些方面的进展，请阅读我们的 Genie 4 模型研究概览。

blocks.text: Earlier this year we introduced Project Genie, an experimental research prototype that lets you generate and explore interactive worlds. Early testers told us they wanted deeper control over what happens inside those worlds, and easier ways to build and share them.

inlines.text: Earlier this year we
introduced Project Genie

, an experimental research prototype that lets you generate and explore interactive worlds. Early testers told us they wanted deeper control over what happens inside those worlds, and easier ways to build and share them.

blocks.text: So today, we are rolling out a new Project Genie experience to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers, making these worlds far more responsive, creative, and social. This update unlocks first-time access to Genie 4, new upgrades to Genie 3, the Project Genie agent which helps users build their vision, and a community gallery to discover, explore, and remix worlds.

blocks.text: Project Genie brings together our most advanced world models alongside our Gemini models, empowering you to generate, step inside, and shape worlds directly from your browser.

blocks.text: Experience Genie 4 in Project Genie

inlines.text: Experience Genie 4 in Project Genie

blocks.text: With Genie 4, our most realistic and interactive world model yet, you can now prompt mid-session to change the world you created. Just type a new prompt while you navigate your world and you can edit your environments in real time. Shift the weather, drop in a character, or redirect the action. For the first time, Genie 4 pairs these visuals with real-time native audio that adapts as the scene unfolds, from ambient soundscapes to character dialogue.

blocks.text: Discover new Genie 3 capabilities

inlines.text: Discover new Genie 3 capabilities

blocks.text: While Genie 4 delivers our highest-fidelity visuals, physics, and native audio, Genie 3 remains available in Project Genie’s model picker when you want longer runs or panorama-seeded spaces. Today’s Genie 3 updates include:

inlines.text: While Genie 4 delivers our highest-fidelity visuals, physics, and native audio, Genie 3 remains available in Project Genie’s model picker when you want longer runs or panorama-seeded spaces. Today’s Genie 3 updates include:
Extended sessions and world chaining:
Explore for up to 3 minutes per generation (up from 60 seconds), or link multiple worlds together for longer journeys.
360-degree panorama image grounding:
Seed new worlds from 360-degree panorama images.
Real-time in-world events:
Dynamically change the environment with natural-language prompts while you explore.

blocks.text: Create new interactive experiences

inlines.text: Create new interactive experiences

blocks.text: The new Project Genie agent takes creation beyond a single text or image prompt. Now crafting an interactive universe is as effortless as having a conversation. Simply describe your vision in natural language, and the agent orchestrates Google’s suite of multimodal models to craft initial visuals establishing your world’s signature look, paired with custom background scores tailored to the mood.

inlines.text: The new Project Genie agent takes creation beyond a single text or image prompt. Now crafting an interactive universe is as effortless as having a conversation. Simply describe your vision in natural language, and the agent orchestrates Google’s suite of multimodal models to craft initial visuals establishing your world’s signature look, paired with custom background scores tailored to the mood.

blocks.text: You can also bring Gemini models into the session as you explore: it observes what is happening on screen, surfaces context-aware suggestion chips for where to go next, or triggers in-world events automatically as your journey unfolds.

blocks.text: Explore the new gallery

inlines.text: Explore the new gallery

blocks.text: When you just want to jump straight into exploring, the new Project Genie gallery brings together a rich collection of curated worlds alongside creative work from the community. Transform personal photos into explorable spaces in “Living Memory,” wander through rich prehistoric habitats grounded in 360-degree panoramas in “Dino Field Guide,” or pit themed objects against one another on a desk with Gemini serving as your real-time referee in “Rock Paper Scissors.”

inlines.text: When you just want to jump straight into exploring, the new Project Genie gallery brings together a rich collection of curated worlds alongside creative work from the community. blocks.text: The gallery also showcases inspiring collaborations with pioneering creators who had early access to these tools. Teaming up with creative technologist Will aka BLVCKL!GHT, we created “Villa Giallo,” an atmospheric, room-by-room mystery inside a gothic manor. And with filmmaker Anand Gandhi, we built “The Life of Ants,” inviting you to navigate a complex colony from an ant’s perspective, drawing on Genie 4’s stunning photorealism.

inlines.text: Learn how we are building responsibly

blocks.text: We are committed to developing and rolling out interactive world models responsibly. All video and audio generated in Project Genie includes SynthID watermarking, and all model inputs and outputs go through safety screenings.

blocks.text: Genie 3 and Genie 4 remain world models in the frontier research space. As the research continues to evolve, we are actively tackling key challenges such as camera latency, intricate physical interactions, real-time audio precision, and long-term scene permanence. For a deeper look into model limitations and our progress on these fronts, read our Genie 4 model research overview.
